guide.stdout:
Napplet Guide
=============

2. Create the starter
   napplet create my-napplet
   cd my-napplet
   Scaffold docs: https://napplet.run/docs/packages/boilerplate.html

3. Configure deployment metadata
   napplet init
   CLI docs: https://napplet.run/docs/packages/cli.html

4. Equip your agent
   npx skills add napplet/napplet
   Skills docs: https://napplet.run/docs/guide/agent-skills.html

5. Build and verify
   pnpm install
   pnpm verify
   Agent build guide: https://napplet.run/docs/guide/build-note-drafts-napplet-with-ai-agent-and-skills.html

6. Preview, then deploy
   napplet paja -- pnpm vite --host 127.0.0.1
   napplet deploy --dry-run
   napplet deploy
   Deploy docs: https://napplet.run/docs/packages/cli.html

Documentation
-------------
Getting started: https://napplet.run/docs/guide/getting-started.html
CLI reference: https://napplet.run/docs/packages/cli.html
All docs: https://napplet.run/docs/
